normal.1: Performs up to 3 consecutive spear strikes.

charged.1: Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to perform an upward thrust.

description.0: Behold the true meaning of "cooking"! Escoffier will demonstrate different cooking techniques when you Tap or Hold this skill, but rest assured, each of them is Fontaine's pride and joy.
description.3: Activates her All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek in its Cold Storage mode and deals <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo> to nearby opponents.
description.6: Follows the current active character and fires Frosty Parfaits at nearby opponents at intervals, dealing <cryo>Cryo DMG</cryo>.
description.9: At intervals, Escoffier will summon a Surging Blade when activating her Cooking Mek in Cold Storage mode, dealing Ousia-aligned <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo>.
description.12: Activates her Cooking Mek's {LINK#P1122301}Off-the-Cuff Cookery{/LINK} mode.

description.0: Displaying her exceptional knife skills, Escoffier deals <cryo>AoE Cryo DMG</cryo> and restores HP to all nearby party members based on her ATK.
description.2: Cutting is like playing a moving melody, and the finished dish, filled with flavor and adorned in aroma, is your completed composition.

description.0: After using the Elemental Burst {LINK#S11125}Scoring Cuts{/LINK}, Escoffier will obtain the Rehab Diet effect for 9s: Restores HP for nearby active characters at intervals based on 138.24% of Escoffier's ATK.

When the party has 1/2/3/4 Hydro or Cryo characters in the party, Escoffier will decrease the Hydro RES and Cryo RES of any opponents hit by her Elemental Skill, {LINK#S11122}Low-Temperature Cooking{/LINK}, or her Elemental Burst, {LINK#S11125}Scoring Cuts{/LINK}, by 5%/10%/15%/55% for 12s.
When using the Hold form of her Elemental Skill Low-Temperature Cooking, Escoffier will activate her All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek in its Off-the-Cuff Cookery mode.
3: Places the Cooking mek on the field. The Cooking Mek can absorb elemental attacks. When the absorbed elemental energy hits a certain limit, Escoffier can convert the ingredients placed within it into delicious dishes.
Escoffier needs time to purchase new ingredients. After making a certain number of dishes, 7 days will pass before more can be made.
